equipment.name: Combat drugs
equipment.desc:
Once per battle, select any number of abilities for the model when performing a Charge command:
- +1 Attack
- +1" Charge move
- +1 Strength
- +1 Weapon Skill
- The "Warded" ability
The effects last until the end of the current battle round. Roll 1D6 for each selected ability. The model suffers one Mortal Wound for each matching die roll result.

equipment.name: Doom siren
equipment.desc: Select one enemy unit within 9" range during your activation that is currently not engaged in melee and roll 3D6. For each 4+ the target suffers one automatic wound with Strength: 4 AP: -1 D: 1; Sunder(2), Suppression(6).

equipment.name: Rapturous Aura
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit gain the "Berserk(5+)" ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Sonic shrieker
equipment.desc: If model and its attached the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, enemies suffer -1 to melee hit rolls until the end of the current battle round.

equipment.name: Sub-sonic pulser
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit always gain the benefit of the "Hold Your Ground" Defensive Reaction.

equipment.name: Xenotech stinger
equipment.desc: The model can make one additional melee attack per round. Strength: 2 AP: -4 D: 1. Hits wound automatically.

equipment.name: Doom Siren
equipment.desc: Select one enemy unit within 9" range during your activation that is currently not engaged in melee and roll 3D6. For each 4+ the target suffers one automatic wound with Strength: 4 AP: -1 D: 1; Sunder(2), Suppression(6).

equipment.name:
3rd Company Elite 
(Traitor only)
equipment.desc:
- Kakophoni Squad units may be taken as Troops.
- Only Kakophoni Squad units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- The army must have the Traitor alignment.

equipment.name: Maru Skara
equipment.desc:
- At the beginning of the Deployment Phase, select up 1-3 Elites, Troops or Fast Attack units that do not have the "Unyielding" ability. These units gain the "Outflank" ability. From the second round onwards, these units may be deployed together from Reserves using the "Outflanking" ability without making a Reserves roll.
- In the first round, units which began the game deployed on the table gain +2" Movement.
- The army cannot take any units with 0" Movement characteristic.
